title: 第11章 栖身山洞第12章 猴儿酒
content_zh:
当时在上官家大宅，白邵阳就受到白发黑衣蒙面人的致命一击，当时无暇治疗，一路狂奔，凭借对张家的一腔忠勇硬撑到暗夜禁地。
在入口处借助那位元婴八层巅峰蒙面人的一记攻击使他们进入暗夜禁地。
那位元婴八层巅峰蒙面人担心将张皓旸击杀，所以仅用十分之一的力量，即使是十分之一的力量，那也是元婴境八层巅峰的十分之一，已经重伤在身的白邵阳如何承受的起?
蒙面人的这一击已将白邵阳的五脏六腑震碎。
在进入暗夜禁地后白邵阳背着张皓旸一番全力奔跑，终于无法支撑重伤力竭而亡。
看着自己熟悉的亲人一个个离自己而去，先是父母、哥哥、族人再到现在的白邵阳，张皓旸悲痛欲绝，他为自己面对危险时的无能为力自责，他为自己的修为过低无法保护至亲之人自责，他现在能做的只有痛哭，他抱住白邵阳的尸体大声痛哭，泪流满面。
如若不是白邵阳，恐怕他在张家祖庙就已身死，现在终于支撑着躲过蒙面人的追杀熬到了暗夜禁地，就在能看到一点点曙光时他却又负伤身死，这让张皓旸如何不悲痛？如何不伤心欲绝？
张皓旸哭了很久，当眼泪流干时，他拿出那柄刺中白发黑衣蒙面人的玄铁匕首将周围灌木砍断，然后又挖出一个深坑将白邵阳的尸体埋葬于此。
他找到一根断木，用沾满鲜血和泥巴的手拿着匕首将断木削平然后刻上“白邵阳之墓，孙儿张皓旸泣立！”
插到土堆之上。
张皓旸向坟墓磕了三个响头，他在白邵阳的墓前他发誓，只要他能逃出此地就一定为白邵阳报仇，为父母、哥哥和族人报仇。
他要重建张家，要将白邵阳迁到张家祖庙供奉。
在办完这一切后，张皓旸起身开始打量四周，他要活着离开此地，否则报仇根本无从谈起！
只见四周全是粗壮树木，每一棵树都有成年人双手环抱那么粗，地上长满各类灌木、花草。
此时暗夜禁地森林外应该是正午时分，而此处大树枝繁叶茂将阳光遮挡仅有微弱阳光透过树叶间缝隙照进来。
张皓旸四周雾气蒙蒙，向远处看去，最多也就能看清十丈范围内的景物，再远就无法看清了；刚才一直处于悲伤之中，未曾感到此处空气的异常，此时呼吸起来，方才感到呼吸困难，身体无比难受。
此处的雾气被称作毒瘴，内含大量毒气，吸入后就会感到胸闷、头晕、呼吸困难，如果长时间呼吸此种空气，肯定会中毒身亡。
暗夜禁地的毒瘴也是外界那些武者不愿进入此地的一个原因。
外曾祖父上官天龙给他的空间戒指中有解毒丹药，感受此处空气的异常后，他立即取出一粒解毒丹服下，以便能缓解中毒的症状，为他争取更多的时间离开此地。
此时，远处突然传来妖兽的吼叫之声。

张皓旸立即警惕起来。
此处的毒瘴靠解毒丹药可以临时克服，但是如果遇到妖兽，凭借他的修为和现在的身体状况根本无法与高阶的妖兽抗衡，哪怕是遇到低阶的妖兽恐怕取胜也比较困难，到时必定会成为妖兽的美食。
现在迫在眉睫的是要尽快找个临时安身之处，以便休息栖身，否则一旦到了晚上那些高阶妖兽出没，可想而知其后果！
想到这里，张皓旸就立即动身四处寻找起栖身之处来。
张皓旸在暗夜禁地森林中漫无目的地四处寻找着，经过近三个时辰的寻找，终于在一棵三人环抱粗的大树后面发现一个被树枝遮挡可容人直立通过的山洞。
张皓旸将山洞外覆盖的树枝拿掉，发现山洞很深，完全可以临时藏身在此处躲避夜晚外出觅食的妖兽。
张皓旸走进山洞，里面漆黑一片，他从外曾祖父上官天龙给他的空间戒指中找到一块耀光石，右手拿着耀光石举起照着路继续向山洞里面走去。
山洞很大很深，他向山洞里走了数百丈还未到尽头。
手拿耀光石照亮，他谨慎前行，在又向山洞深处走了数百丈后竟是发现山洞里面放着许多泥罐。
每个泥罐都有三尺高，成人腰粗，泥罐上面都用较大的树叶覆盖，用暗夜禁地森林中特有的红泥将树叶周边密封住泥罐灌口四周。
张皓旸走进山洞已有数百米，一直未发现妖兽，张皓旸壮着胆继续向山洞深处走去。
只见越往里走，摆放的泥罐就越多，出于好奇，张皓旸走到一个泥罐前，俯身撕开用红泥密封的树叶。
就在他撕开树叶的瞬间，一股沁入心脾的香气立即袭来。
他拿着耀光石向泥罐里面照去，透过耀光石可以看到泥罐里面全是液体，液体呈金黄色并不浓稠，香气扑鼻，那种浓郁的香气让张皓旸竟是有些垂涎。
张皓旸突破到炼体境七层巅峰时已是寅时，而后就遇到蒙面人去上官家捉拿他，与蒙面人一番对峙后就被白邵阳背着来到暗夜禁地，在此处寻找栖身之地又用去数个时辰。
这么长时间里，他未吃未喝，现在乍一闻到如此扑鼻的液体，他竟不由自主的将嘴放到泥罐边缘喝了一口。
液体入口甘甜，回味醇香，略有些微辣。
液体入口，回味无穷，液体入腹，消耗的体力竟有些恢复。
见液体无毒，又能恢复自己体力，有此发现，张皓旸干脆就抱起泥罐大口喝起来。
在喝完泥罐的三分之一时，丹田就略微有种灼烧的感觉，但是由于液体过于醇厚、过于香甜，张皓旸也就不管三七二十一继续大口喝起来。

初饮时不觉，在喝完第一罐时，丹田灼烧之感竟越来越强烈，导致他全身微颤，但是此液体确实香甜可口，他在喝完第一罐后紧接着就打开第二罐，在第二罐又喝了大约三分之一后，酒劲上涌，只见他身体摇晃，最终站立不稳摔倒在地。

content_en:
At that time, in the Shangguan family mansion, Bai Shaoyang received a fatal blow from a masked man with white hair and black clothes. He had no time to treat him and ran all the way, relying on his loyalty to the Zhang family to survive to the dark night forbidden area.
At the entrance, they entered the dark night forbidden area with the help of an attack from the masked man at the eighth level of Nascent Soul.
The masked man at the peak of the eighth level of Nascent Soul was worried about killing Zhang Haoyang, so he only used one-tenth of his strength. Even one-tenth of the power was still one-tenth of the peak of the eighth level of Nascent Soul. How could Bai Shaoyang, who was already seriously injured, bear it?
The blow from the masked man had shattered Bai Shaoyang's internal organs.
After entering the dark night forbidden area, Bai Shaoyang ran with all his strength with Zhang Haoyang on his back, but was finally unable to sustain the serious injuries and died of exhaustion.
Seeing his familiar relatives leaving him one by one, first his parents, brother, clan members, and now Bai Shaoyang, Zhang Haoyang was devastated. He blamed himself for his inability to face danger. He blamed himself for his low cultivation level and was unable to protect his loved ones. All he could do now was cry bitterly. He hugged Bai Shaoyang's body and cried loudly, with tears streaming down his face.
If it weren't for Bai Shaoyang, he might have died in the Zhangjia Ancestral Temple. Now he finally managed to escape the pursuit of the masked man and made it to the dark night forbidden area. Just when he could see a little light, he was wounded and died. How could Zhang Haoyang not be sad? How not to be heartbroken?
Zhang Haoyang cried for a long time. When the tears ran dry, he took out the black iron dagger that stabbed the white-haired and black-clothed masked man, cut off the surrounding bushes, and then dug a deep pit to bury Bai Shaoyang's body here.
He found a broken piece of wood, flattened it with a dagger in his hands stained with blood and mud, and then carved the words "In the tomb of Bai Shaoyang, his grandson Zhang Haoyang stood crying!"
Inserted on top of the mound.
Zhang Haoyang kowtowed to the grave three times. He swore in front of Bai Shaoyang's grave that as long as he could escape from here, he would avenge Bai Shaoyang, his parents, brother and clan members.
He wanted to rebuild the Zhang family and move Bai Shaoyang to the Zhang family ancestral temple to worship him.
After finishing all this, Zhang Haoyang stood up and began to look around. He had to leave this place alive, otherwise revenge would be impossible!
All around I saw thick trees, each of which was as thick as an adult's hands wrapped around each other. The ground was covered with various shrubs, flowers and plants.
It should be noon outside the Dark Night Forbidden Forest, and the large branches and leaves here block the sun and only weak sunlight shines through the gaps between the leaves.
There was mist all around Zhang Haoyang, and when he looked into the distance, he could only see the scenery within ten feet at most, but couldn't see anything further away. He had been in sadness just now, and had never felt anything unusual in the air here. When he started to breathe now, he felt difficulty breathing and his body was extremely uncomfortable.
The mist here is called poisonous miasma, and it contains a large amount of poisonous gas. After inhaling it, you will feel chest tightness, dizziness, and difficulty breathing. If you breathe this kind of air for a long time, you will definitely be poisoned and die.
The poisonous miasma in the Dark Night Forbidden Land is also one of the reasons why warriors from the outside world are reluctant to enter this place.
There was an antidote pill in the space ring given to him by his great-grandfather Shangguan Tianlong. After feeling the abnormality in the air here, he immediately took out an antidote pill and drank it to relieve the symptoms of poisoning and buy him more time to leave this place.
At this time, the roar of a monster suddenly came from the distance.
Zhang Haoyang immediately became vigilant.
The poisonous miasma here can be temporarily overcome with antidote pills, but if he encounters a monster, his cultivation and current physical condition will not be able to compete with a high-level monster. Even if he encounters a low-level monster, it will be difficult to win, and he will definitely become the monster's delicacy.
What is urgent now is to find a temporary shelter as soon as possible for rest and shelter, otherwise once those high-level monsters appear at night, you can imagine the consequences!
Thinking of this, Zhang Haoyang immediately set out to look for a place to stay.
Zhang Haoyang in the dark forestI searched around aimlessly in the forest. After nearly three hours of searching, I finally found a cave behind a big tree surrounded by three people, which was blocked by branches and could allow people to pass upright.
Zhang Haoyang removed the branches covering the outside of the cave and found that the cave was very deep, and he could temporarily hide here to avoid the monsters that went out to look for food at night.
Zhang Haoyang walked into the cave. It was pitch dark inside. He found a radiant stone from the space ring given to him by his great-grandfather Shangguan Tianlong. He held the radiant stone in his right hand and continued to walk into the cave according to the path.
The cave was very large and deep. He walked hundreds of feet into the cave before reaching the end.
Holding the shining stone in his hand to illuminate, he moved forward cautiously. After walking several hundred feet deeper into the cave, he discovered that there were many clay jars inside the cave.
Each clay pot is three feet high and as thick as an adult's waist. The top of the clay pot is covered with larger leaves. The red mud unique to the forest in the Dark Night Forbidden Land is used to seal the edges of the leaves around the mouth of the clay pot.
Zhang Haoyang walked hundreds of meters into the cave and still found no monster. Zhang Haoyang bravely continued walking deeper into the cave.
The further inside, the more clay jars were placed. Out of curiosity, Zhang Haoyang walked to a clay jar and leaned over to tear open the leaves sealed with red mud.
The moment he tore open the leaves, a refreshing aroma immediately hit him.
He took the shining stone and shined it into the clay jar. Through the shining stone, he could see that the clay jar was full of liquid. The liquid was golden yellow but not thick, and had a fragrant aroma. The rich aroma made Zhang Haoyang salivate.
It was Yinshi when Zhang Haoyang broke through to the peak of the seventh level of the Body Refining Realm. Then he encountered a masked man who went to Shangguan's house to capture him. After a confrontation with the masked man, he was carried by Bai Shaoyang to the Dark Night Forbidden Land. He spent several hours looking for a place to stay here.
He hadn't eaten or drank for such a long time, and now when he smelled such a tangy liquid, he couldn't help but put his mouth to the edge of the clay pot and took a sip.
The liquid is sweet in the mouth, has a mellow aftertaste, and is slightly spicy.
The liquid enters the mouth, and the aftertaste is endless. The liquid enters the stomach, and the energy consumed is somewhat restored.
Seeing that the liquid was non-toxic and could restore his physical strength, Zhang Haoyang simply picked up the clay pot and drank it.
After finishing one-third of the clay pot, there was a slight burning sensation in the Dantian, but because the liquid was too mellow and sweet, Zhang Haoyang ignored it and continued to drink.
Unexpectedly when he first drank it, after finishing the first can, the burning sensation in his pubic area became stronger and stronger, causing his whole body to tremble slightly. However, the liquid was indeed sweet and delicious. He opened the second can immediately after drinking the first can. After drinking about one-third of the second can, the wine was so strong that he shook his body, and finally lost his balance and fell to the ground.
